notes.title: Small visual and detail updates
notes.notes: Some small updates to add some more interactive objects, some visual tweaks, added an otter (!), two new NPC portraits, and a new NPC to bring the story a little closer to Clare's account.

notes.title: Now with added Steam achievements!
notes.notes:
A small patch to add Steam achievements. There are five to collect (so far). 

There's a bigger patch coming with lots of new visual tweaks and improvements. Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Mac now supported on Steam
notes.notes:
It's been a slog, but I think I've finally got the Mac build working through Steam now. 

Please let me know if you have any issues because there is a ton of complexity with exporting an app for Mac that makes it all a bit of an adventure.

This brings Mac to parity with the PC version, so there's some nicer visuals, some sticky horse bugs have been fixed and other miscellaneous stuff too.

[b]Please message me if anything is broken![/b] And I'll get back on it

notes.title: The best bugs need fixing twice
notes.notes: So, I missed a few controller bugs. Plus I took the opportunity to fix a speed issue and update the ampersand in the font to it... well... looked like an ampersand.

notes.title: Rogue bugs and boxes
notes.notes: Small tweaks to fix some missing prompt triggers on controllers, adjusting cutscenes for Steam Deck and added some box-pushing states so it's a little clearer.

notes.title: Winter in Epping Forest - Winter sale now on
notes.notes:
Perhaps John Clare is looking over Epping Forest from the Owl pub and considering an escape when the weather improves....

notes.title: A particularly sticky horse
notes.notes: Fixed a sticky horse that wouldn't let the conversation go. Thank you Sam for finding and letting me know!

notes.title: Lost papers complete
notes.notes:
There are [b]seven lost papers[/b] to find across the game containing fragments of Clare's poems. 

If you collect them all, you'll now see a special new menu item... 

[b]Collect them all for a reward![/b]

notes.title: Cloudy mood vibes
notes.notes:
A mini-patch to add some mood clouds in the later third of the walk and some super-tiny tweaks to some grass... 

In the works are the collectibles. The Mac build has all been accepted by the app store, just going through some extra paperwork before it can finally go live.

notes.title: Controller support!
notes.notes:
[b]Added support for controllers[/b]
You should now be able to switch between keyboard or any controller at any time... I believe it supports a wide range of different controllers, but if you have any problems please let me know.

notes.title: Tiny post release patch
notes.notes:
Fixing a surprise bug related to birds... and adding in a loader for audio. 
Still working on how to get this approved for Mac...
